title: Core agents, middleware, signals, traces
routing: Is this about foundry-core's agent building blocks: BaseAgent and its kinds (Executor, Decider, Classifier, Router, Clarifier, Planner), the Harness (classify → route → dispatch, every message traced), thread.dispatch / thread.fan(), toolUseLoop, resolveAgentOpts; the MiddlewareChain around dispatch (use / useWhen, retryMiddleware, ReactiveMiddleware, budgetGuardHook, planModeHook, HookRegistry, lifecycle hooks, DispatchContext); the side channels (SignalBus, EventStream, InterventionLog, ActionQueue, BoundedSet, Signal and Intervention rows); or Trace spans and trace records (serializeTrace, upsertTraceRecord, prepareCheckpointImport)? Plain jobs: make an agent that returns only a decision, pick where a message goes, wrap or retry every dispatch, stop agents once the budget is spent, broadcast a correction, stream events to the UI, record and replay how one message travelled.

recognise.note: recognise/pick split under test (model round); not the standard
